zh.title: 搜索，如何带来访客？
zh.subtitle: 以一个假设的冥想计时页面为例
zh.caveat: 一条可能的路径，每一步都可能中断。

nodes.label: 人有问题
nodes.caption: 想安静冥想 5 分钟
nodes.explanation: 从真实需要开始。此时，对方还不知道你的页面。

nodes.label: 发起搜索
nodes.caption: 搜索「5 分钟冥想计时」
nodes.explanation: 用户把需要变成搜索词。

nodes.label: 看到结果
nodes.caption: 页面可能出现在结果中
nodes.explanation: 被收录不保证展示，展示也不保证位置。

nodes.label: 进入页面
nodes.caption: 觉得合适，才可能点进来
nodes.explanation: 标题和说明让用户判断页面是否值得打开。

nodes.label: 完成计时
nodes.caption: 顺利用完 5 分钟计时
nodes.explanation: 点击之后，页面还需要真正完成用户的任务。

en.title: How search brings visitors
en.subtitle: An example: a hypothetical meditation timer
en.caveat: One possible path. People can stop at any step.

nodes.label: A real need
nodes.caption: “I want 5 quiet minutes.”
nodes.explanation: Start with a real need. The person does not know your page yet.

nodes.label: A search
nodes.caption: “5 minute meditation timer”
nodes.explanation: The person turns their need into a search query.

nodes.label: A result appears
nodes.caption: Your page may be shown
nodes.explanation: Indexing does not guarantee visibility or a particular position.

nodes.label: A page visit
nodes.caption: A good fit may earn a click
nodes.explanation: The title and description help someone decide whether to open the page.

nodes.label: A task completed
nodes.caption: The 5-minute timer works
nodes.explanation: After the click, the page still needs to deliver what the visitor came for.
